parameters.description:
`msg-to-httpsms-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your httpSMS destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own httpSMS destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional httpSMS destinations bound per enrollment.

Sign up at httpsms.com and install the httpSMS Android app on the phone that will send messages, registering its number with your account. From your account's Settings page, copy your API key into HTTPSMS_SMS_APIKEY. Set the sending phone's number as HTTPSMS_SMS_FROM_PHONE and the recipient's number as HTTPSMS_SMS_TO_PHONE, both in E.164 format.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment httpSMS destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to httpSMS Messages API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own httpSMS destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's httpSMS apikey

from_phone_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's httpSMS from phone

to_phone_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's HTTPSMS_SMS_TO_PHONE value (same format as HTTPSMS_SMS_TO_PHONE)
